props.name: children
props.description: The bar's items: `ActionBar.Count`, `ActionBar.Clear`, `ActionBar.Separator` and `ActionBar.Button`. The bar is one Tab stop, and the arrow keys move between its items.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: count
props.description: How many items the selection holds. While it is above zero, the bar rises into place and a visually hidden live region beside it announces the count politely, such as "3 selected", each time it changes. When it returns to zero, the bar falls away and unmounts. If focus was in the bar, as after Clear, focus returns to the element it came from, such as a row checkbox. If that element is gone, as after deleting the selected rows, focus falls to the page.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: If `true`, using keyboard navigation will wrap focus to the other end of the toolbar once the end is reached.

props.name: offset
props.description: The bar's distance from the bottom of its nearest positioned ancestor, in px. Give that ancestor `position: relative` and keep the bar its last child, so the bar paints over the rows. To keep the bar clear of a pagination row or another footer, wrap only the content above the footer in that ancestor. Use `offset` for a small adjustment, such as clearing a faded edge.
